summary.name: Site Reliability Engineering: 4 Things to Know
summary.one_liner: A Network Computing article page on site reliability engineering that now shows a notice that the ITPro Today, Network Computing, and IoT World Today brands merged into Informa TechTarget.
use_cases: Finding an old SRE introduction article
Checking where ITPro Today articles moved after the merger
Browsing reading material for SRE learning
summary.what_it_does: The page as captured is an editor's notice rather than the original article text. It says the URL is no longer supported and that ITPro Today, Network Computing, and IoT World Today merged with Informa TechTarget as of September 2025. It states that the brands' newsletters are no longer published and points readers to TechTarget.com for coverage of networking, IT operations, data management, AI, and cybersecurity. It gives an editorial contact email and a contacts page for finding editors by topic. No SRE content from the original article is present on this page.
notable: Original article content is no longer available at this URL; page is a merger redirect notice
Brands merged into Informa TechTarget as of September 2025

caveats: The original article text is not on this page; only an editor's notice is present
